title: Single/quotient comparison and inverse single shift
statement: Let B be an abelian category with a chosen derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], X an object of B and n a natural number. Let K_i be the bounded-below homotopy single object on X in degree i, let e_i : single_i(X) ≅ Qh(K_i) be the canonical single/quotient comparison, and let h : K_n → K_0[-n] be the inverse single shift. Then e_n inverse followed by the inverse single shift in D⁺(B) equals Qh(h), followed by Qh.commShiftIso(-n) hom at K_0 and the shift by -n of e_0 inverse. These are morphisms from Qh(K_n) to single_0(X)[-n].

proof.text: The single/quotient comparison e_i is the identity: apply the faithful derived inclusion, unfold preimageIso, and the quotient comparison has identity components.

Apply the faithful derived inclusion. Expand the inverse SingleFunctors.lift shift through its whiskering preimage, and expand the ambient single functors as postcomposition by Qh. Compute the inclusion image of the bounded-below Qh shift via Functor.CommShift.OfComp.map_iso_hom_app. Expand the homotopy single shift by the same inverse-lift formula. The inclusion shift comparison and its inverse cancel under Qh; the remaining composites agree.

lean.statement:
theorem single_quotient_inverse_shift (X : B) (n : ℕ) :
    let e (i : ℤ) : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor B i).obj X ≅
        DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.singleFunctor B i).obj X) :=
      DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.preimageIso
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctorIsoCompQ B i).app X ≪≫
        (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso B).symm.app _)
    let K₀ := (HomotopyCategory.Plus.singleFunctor B 0).obj X
    let h := ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.singleFunctors B).shiftIso
      (-(n : ℤ)) n 0 (by simp)).inv.app X
    (e n).inv ≫ ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctors B).shiftIso
      (-(n : ℤ)) n 0 (by simp)).inv.app X =
    DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.map h ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.commShiftIso (-(n : ℤ))).hom.app K₀ ≫
      ((e 0).inv)⟦-(n : ℤ)⟧'
